reviews.review:
2023, had left the game for a year. Long story short, ea app replaced origin and i gave up trying everything short of reinstalling windows just to run this mid game.
2024, after a year, same issue, launcher refuses to launch the game. uninstalled game and launcher.
November 2025, same issue, this time with the "Error on our end" message. Might try again next year.

Proceed at your own risk.

It's a good game. They knew they couldn't top the trilogy, and made peace with it. It tries something new, and I'd say they succeeded. For a 2025 first time playthrough, I say it's a good spin-off.

Writing is a tick below the trilogy, and there is less lore to discover. Fetch quests require a bit too much planet hopping (starfield is still worse).

I did like the characters, jokes are still the good old mass effect.

Honestly it was a lot better than people give credit for, excluding the launch bugs.
Excellent game! with there was more options to do a renegade like path though.
Top game for rog ally or steam deck plays really well

Tried to play it as it's own game, cant reccommend this to anyone really the only thing it really improved on was the fights since it allows a lot of movement but it then falls on its face as you play babysitter to people who can't even so much as walk around the corner and pick up their own socks, I get they want it to seem like your choices have weight and value but their answers to some problems on both sides is HORRIBLE.

Turrian shoots his best friend and goes against orders sure they would have all died following those orders but to then do the security guards job for him and find oh yeah there was a kett there shot him in the back, no one saw the kett but still the guy thought and went through with trying to kill his commander and friend, I would not allow him to serve in security or have him dishonorable discharged but no you get two choices, exile him or let him free. No middle ground .

How many times can I listen to sam tell me about the tempurture or about every single encampment nearby saying there is tech there ((there is not)) old mission promps still voice as if they are still active, folks dont notice MASSIVE monsters nearby and when you kill them by their own mission they go "huh I wonder what happened" they are all wet blankets whining about how they dont know what to do or there is no way to do something, yet in the same breath they will say "however there might be...ohhh yeah you could go" your ♥♥♥♥♥ Mc go get em for every fetch quest you could imagine for folks who complain constantly and all while textures fail to load  you can see mountains and objects floating off surfaces, neck breaking refusing to turn to talk, and just so much horrible writing and acting, I have not felt a single emotion besides iritation and curiosity but eventually you see the writing on the wall and give up, glad I played the original trilogy again because it gave me this game as a slap on extra, I would never pay for this game otherwise. Better off playing the originals at least they try to make an emotion come out of you.
